title: The Third Row
text: Engram's orange, bleached by an unfiltered sun to the colour of old bone. The same hulls. These carry no cryo racks at all: where ours hold the bank, theirs hold a data vault, and every vault has been opened and wiped. ENGRAM 11. ENGRAM 10.

lines.text: "Eleven of Engram too. It's going to want to know about this. I'm not sure I want to be the one who tells it."
